citations.label: Peec AI, Publish stats, get cited (laundering chain)
citations.excerpt: On day one, a fake number on StateGlobe had zero authority. It was a random stat on a brand-new domain.  Then an academic paper cited it. Then a bank. Now the next person, or the next model, that finds this number sees a stat with a source.

citations.label: Peec AI, Publish stats, get cited (trust)
citations.excerpt: The fake data certainly didn't become true, but every citation made it look more trustworthy.

citations.label: Peec AI, Publish stats, get cited (grounding pipeline)
citations.excerpt: A search-grounded piece of LLM-written content has a tight budget for latency and cost. The system fetches a few pages, pulls the relevant passages, and starts to write.

citations.label: Peec AI, Publish stats, get cited (rerankers)
citations.excerpt: To get around this, LLMs use rerankers that score relevance, but not truth. That means if a passage matches the query and looks authoritative, it gets used.

citations.label: Peec AI, Publish stats, get cited (verification cost)
citations.excerpt: Across billions of prompts by millions of users, the costs in both time and money would add up, making verification too slow and too expensive for practical purposes.
